sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN UPPER LOW AND SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL TAKE ON A NEGATIVE TILT AS IT EJECTS NEWD ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION TODAY WITH AN 80-90 KT MID LEVEL SPEED MAX. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE WILL MOVE FROM SRN MANITOBA INTO WRN ONTARIO WITH A RELATIVELY SHARP LOW PRESSURE TROUGH/COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWD ACROSS MN INTO NRN MO DURING THE MORNING...WEAKENING A BIT AS IT LIFTS NEWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES. TO THE W...A LARGE UPPER LOW WILL BE NEARLY STATIONARY JUST OFF THE PACIFIC COAST...WITH A BROAD AREA OF SWLY FLOW FROM CA INTO THE GREAT BASIN. IN ASSOCIATION WITH THIS TROUGH AND WITH DAYTIME HEATING...A WEAK LOW PRESSURE TROUGH WILL LIE ROUGHLY FROM ERN WA INTO NRN NV.

sections.title: WI/MI AND NRN IL/IND/OH
sections.text: WIND PROFILES WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY UNIDIRECTIONAL ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR DUE TO MIXING AND ALSO A SLIGHT WEAKENING/LIFTING OUT OF THE SURFACE LOW TO THE N. DESPITE THIS...DEEP LAYER FLOW FIELDS WILL BE STRONG AND FAVOR ORGANIZED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. INDICATIONS ARE THAT STORMS WILL INCREASE IN COVERAGE ALONG THE COLD FRONT ACROSS WRN UPPER MI AND CNTRL WI BY MIDDAY AND INCREASE IN INTENSITY AND ORGANIZATION AS THEY MOVE ACROSS NRN IL...NRN IND...AND EWD ACROSS LOWER MI BY LATE AFTERNOON. MIXED STORM MODES MAY OCCUR...WITH FAST MOVING LINE SEGMENTS/BOWS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS EARLY. WITH TIME...THE DOMINANT STORM MODE SHOULD BE QUASI-LINEAR WITH THE POSSIBILITY OF WIDESPREAD SEVERE WINDS. TORNADO THREAT WILL BE LIMITED BY VEERED LOW LEVEL FLOW AND WEAK EFFECTIVE SRH...AS WELL AS LINEAR STORM MODE WITH TIME.

sections.title: COASTAL NC/SC/GA
sections.text: A NELY FLOW REGIME WILL BE IN PLACE WITH THE UPPER HIGH CENTERED TO THE NW. IN THE LOW LEVELS...MID TO UPPER 60S F DEWPOINTS ARE LIKELY WITH FLOW OFF THE ATLANTIC...WHILE STRONG DAYTIME HEATING OCCURS INLAND WITH HINTS OF A WEAK LOW PRESSURE TROUGH BY AFTERNOON OVER SRN NC/ERN SC. THE NAM STEEPENS BOUNDARY LAYER LAPSE RATES PERHAPS A LITTLE TOO MUCH IN COMPARISON TO THE GFS AND NAMKF SOUNDINGS...AND SUGGESTS A BETTER CHANCE OF STORMS. WHILE A WEAK UPPER FEATURE IS EXPECTED TO GLANCE THE AREA...OVERALL POTENTIAL APPEARS TOO LOW FOR A SLIGHT AT THIS TIME. ANY STORMS THAT DO FORM WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: MO/OK/TX
sections.text: A WEAK FRONTAL BOUNDARY WILL STRETCH ROUGHLY FROM CNTRL MO INTO OK AND NWRN TX THIS AFTERNOON...WITH AMPLE INSTABILITY PRESENT BY LATE AFTERNOON. ALTHOUGH CIN WILL ERODE DURING THE DAY...OVERALL FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE WEAK...ESPECIALLY OVER TX WHERE UPPER HEIGHT RISES WILL OCCUR. STILL...STRONG HEATING SHOULD LEAD TO AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY ALONG THE ENTIRE ZONE. PULSE TO MULTICELL STORMS CAPABLE MARGINAL HAIL/WIND ARE MOST LIKELY. AFTER 00Z...A SLY LOW LEVEL JET IS FORECAST TO INCREASE OVER THE SRN PLAINS...WHICH WILL BRING MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY NWD. THIS MAY HELP FORCE SOME WEAK ACTIVITY INTO SRN KS...BUT CONCERNS ABOUT CIN AND DEGREE OF FORCING CURRENT LIMIT SEVERE PROBABILITIES.

sections.title: SERN WA/NERN ORE/NRN ID/WRN MT
sections.text: WITH UPPER TROUGH TO THE W...DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR A FEW LONG LIVED...POSSIBLY WEAKLY ROTATING STORMS THIS AFTERNOON. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT WITH MODEST LOW LEVEL VEERING. DAYTIME HEATING AND CONVERGENCE IN THE LOW PRESSURE TROUGH SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS...SOME OF WHICH MAY CONTAIN MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. ..JEWELL.. 05/31/2011

sections.title: ERN WI/NRN IL/NRN INDIANA/MI AREA TODAY
sections.text: A STRONG MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED 70-90 KT 500 MB JET CORE WILL EJECT ENEWD FROM THE ERN DAKOTAS/NEB TO THE MI AREA BY THIS EVENING...AROUND THE NWRN PERIPHERY OF A MIDLEVEL RIDGE OVER THE OH VALLEY AND APPALACHIANS. AN ACCOMPANYING SURFACE COLD FRONT WILL LIKEWISE MOVE EWD ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND UPPER GREAT LAKES BY TONIGHT...TO THE S/SE OF AN OCCLUDED LOW OVER WRN ONTARIO. SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE FOCUSED TODAY IN ADVANCE OF THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH AND THE SURFACE COLD FRONT. THE RECENT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS NRN MO POSES SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING DEBRIS CLOUDINESS DOWNSTREAM THIS AFTERNOON OVER IL/WI...BUT SHOULD HAVE LESS IMPACT ON THE MDT RISK AREA IN LOWER MI. THE PRIMARY CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY MIDDAY/EARLY AFTN ACROSS E/SE WI AND NRN IL AHEAD OF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT...IN THE ZONE OF ASCENT IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH. DOWNSTREAM BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 60S AND AFTERNOON TEMPERATURES WELL INTO THE 80S WILL RESULT IN WEAKENING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION AND MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J PER KG/ ACROSS LOWER MI. THUS...EXPECT THE EARLY AFTERNOON STORMS TO EXPAND AND INTENSIFY N

sections.title: SE NM/W TX THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: A COLD FRONT WILL STALL TODAY ACROSS W TX AND THEN BEGIN TO RETREAT NWWD AS A WARM FRONT LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT. THOUGH GRADUAL HEIGHT RISES ARE EXPECTED OVER THIS AREA TODAY... ISOLATED-SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED ALONG THE FRONT LATE THIS AFTERNOON AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES WELL INTO THE 90S AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 60S WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE VALUES OF 2500-3000 J/KG AND WEAKENING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. THIS AREA WILL ALSO REMAIN UNDER THE SERN FRINGE OF THE STRONGER MIDLEVEL WSWLY FLOW...WHERE SELY SURFACE WINDS WILL RESULT IN SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. THUS...AT LEAST ISOLATED LARGE HAIL CAN BE EXPECTED WITH THE STRONGER STORMS...AS WELL AS DAMAGING WINDS GIVEN STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND THE POTENTIAL FOR STORM MERGERS THIS EVENING.

sections.title: SC COASTAL PLAIN AREA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A REMNANT MCV WILL MOVE SWWD JUST OFF THE CAROLINAS TODAY...WITH LARGE SCALE RIDGING THE DOMINANT INFLUENCE. STILL...ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE SEA BREEZE...AND DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE ENHANCED BY NELY FLOW BETWEEN THE MCV AND THE RIDGE. IF ISOLATED STORMS FORM...THE ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED SMALL CLUSTERS MOVING SWWD ALONG THE SEA BREEZE BOUNDARY...WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL.

sections.title: INTERIOR NW AREA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: WEAK INSTABILITY IS EXPECTED BENEATH THE EXIT REGION OF THE MID-UPPER JET...WHERE A FEW THUNDERSTORMS COULD FORM IN CLOUD BREAKS. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED STORMS...THE STRONGEST OF WHICH MAY PRODUCE STRONG WINDS AND ISOLATED HAIL NEAR OR JUST BELOW THE SEVERE CRITERION. ..THOMPSON/GARNER.. 05/31/2011

sections.title: TX/NM/OK
sections.text: STRONG DAYTIME HEATING WILL OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON OVER PORTIONS OF WEST TX...WITH SOUTHEASTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS RETURNING RICH MOISTURE INTO REGION. BY EARLY EVENING...MODERATE CAPE WITH WEAK CINH ARE EXPECTED ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE RETREATING WEAK SURFACE BOUNDARY. MID LEVEL HEIGHTS WILL BE RISING ACROSS THIS REGION THROUGH THE PERIOD...BUT A CONCENSUS OF MODEL SOLUTIONS INDICATES THAT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL FORM DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING HOURS. THOSE STORMS THAT FORM WILL BE IN AN ENVIRONMENT OF SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER EFFECTIVE SHEAR SUPPORTIVE FOR SUPERCELLS. STEEP LOW AND MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL PROMOTE A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. ..HART/GRAMS.. 05/31/2011

sections.title: 20Z UPDATE
sections.text: ...GREAT LAKES REGION... WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR OF A DEEP SURFACE CYCLONE NOW MIGRATING ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN MANITOBA INTO NORTHWEST ONTARIO...18Z RAOBS ACROSS LOWER MICHIGAN EXHIBIT PROFILES CHARACTERIZED BY FAIRLY STEEP LAPSE RATES AND MODERATELY LARGE MIXED LAYER CAPE /1000-2000 J PER KG/ IN THE PRESENCE OF A SHEARED AND MODESTLY STRONG WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW /ON THE ORDER OF 40 KT/. SOME STRENGTHENING OF WIND FIELDS APPEARS LIKELY AS THE BROADER SCALE UPSTREAM CLOSED LOW/TROUGH CONTINUES TO LIFT NORTHEASTWARD LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING...BUT FORCING AND FOCUS FOR CONVECTIVE REMAINS UNCLEAR. LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE SOUTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER AREA REMAINS WEAK. HOWEVER...IT STILL APPEARS THAT FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A SMALLER SCALE IMPULSE LIFTING NORTHEAST OF THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY...TOWARD THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION... COULD CONTRIBUTE TO OR ENHANCE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT LATE THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE SEVERE PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN LOWERED BELOW THE MODERATE RISK THRESHOLD DUE TO INCREASING UNCERTAINTIES CONCERNING POTENTIAL STORM COVERAGE...THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS PORTIONS OF NORTHERN/EASTERN LOWER MICHIGAN APPEARS LIKE IT COULD SUPPORT STRONG GUSTS IN EXCE

sections.title: SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: MODELS CONTINUE TO SUGGEST THAT SCATTERED BOUNDARY LAYER BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL OCCUR LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. THE FOCUS IS UNCLEAR...BUT SLIGHT RISK PROBABILITIES WILL BE MAINTAINED FOR NOW...ADJUSTED TO WHERE BETTER BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION IS WELL UNDERWAY. ..KERR.. 05/31/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1101 AM CDT TUE MAY 31 2011/ A POWERFUL UPPER TROUGH OVER THE MIDWEST WILL ROTATE QUICKLY EASTWARD INTO THE GREAT LAKES REGION TODAY. MEANWHILE...AN ASSOCIATED 80-90 KNOT MID LEVEL JET WILL NOSE INTO MI. THE RESULT WILL BE THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACTIVE SEVERE WEATHER EVENT ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE GREAT LAKES STATES. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING OVER MUCH OF MI. SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S...COUPLED WITH AFTERNOON HIGH TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 80S WILL YIELD MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 3000 J/KG. THIS COMBINED WITH THE STRENGTHENING LOW TO MID LEVEL WIND FIELDS WILL PROVIDE A VERY FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC AND SHEAR ENVIRONMENT FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS. THE PRIMARY FORECAST PROBLEM TODAY INVOLVES THE MODE OF THE CONVECTION. IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL FORM BY EARLY AFTERNOON OVER PORTIONS OF EASTERN WI AND UPPER MI

sections.title: TX/NM/OK
sections.text: STRONG DAYTIME HEATING WILL OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON OVER PORTIONS OF WEST TX...WITH SOUTHEASTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS RETURNING RICH MOISTURE INTO REGION. BY EARLY EVENING...MODERATE CAPE WITH WEAK CINH ARE EXPECTED ALONG AND SOUTH OF THE RETREATING WEAK SURFACE BOUNDARY. MID LEVEL HEIGHTS WILL BE RISING ACROSS THIS REGION THROUGH THE PERIOD...BUT A CONCENSUS OF MODEL SOLUTIONS INDICATES THAT SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL FORM DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING HOURS. THOSE STORMS THAT FORM WILL BE IN AN ENVIRONMENT OF SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER EFFECTIVE SHEAR SUPPORTIVE FOR SUPERCELLS. STEEP LOW AND MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL PROMOTE A RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS ERN LOWER MI
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS SERN NM INTO WRN AND SWRN TX...

sections.title: LOWER MI...IL/IND/OH
sections.text: STORMS WITH OCCASIONAL BOWING SEGMENTS WILL CONTINUE EWD ACROSS LOWER MI WITH A WIND AND MARGINAL HAIL THREAT. AS THE EVENING PROGRESSES...COOLER AND DRIER AIR WILL FILTER IN FROM THE W...AND ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT WILL BE UNLIKELY. FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS...THE GREATEST THREAT WILL BE OVER SERN MI WHERE STRONG INSTABILITY AND SHEAR REMAIN. THE 00Z DTX SOUNDING SHOWED LITTLE CAPPING AND AMPLE INSTABILITY AND SHEAR FOR SEVERE STORMS. THE QUESTION IS WHETHER OR NOT FORCING WILL BE STRONG ENOUGH. RADAR SHOWS SOME BACK BUILDING INDICATIONS AS 0F 0030Z. FARTHER S...VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS LITTLE INDICATION OF FURTHER DEVELOPMENT WITH ONLY WEAK CONVERGENCE. LARGE SCALE FORCING IS ALSO NOT FAVORABLE AS THE UPPER TROUGH EJECTS NEWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES. THE 00Z ILX AND ILN SOUNDINGS BOTH SHOW AMPLE INSTABILITY IN PLACE...WITH FAVORABLE SHEAR ACROSS IL AND IND. WILL MAINTAIN VERY LOW CONDITIONAL SEVERE PROBS FOR ANY ISOLATED STORM THAT MAY FORM. FOR MORE INFORMATION...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1043.

sections.title: SERN NM/WRN TX
sections.text: SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL PERSIST ACROSS SERN NM AND WRN TX WHERE BACKED SURFACE FLOW CONTINUES TO BRING MOISTURE WWD INTO A REGION WHERE STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES EXIST. 00Z MAF SOUNDING SHOWS A CAPPING INVERSION NEAR 700 MB WHICH MAY NOT BODE WELL FOR ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT NEAR AND E OF THAT LONGITUDE THIS EVENING. BUT...A STRONG SELY LOW LEVEL JET COULD HELP SUSTAIN SOME OF THE STRONGER CORES AS THEY DRIFT EWD. ..JEWELL.. 06/01/2011
